name: Crane's Echoing Call
assumptions: Passive "Cloudfall Axiom" is not modelled yet: the weapon contributes only its base ATK and secondary stat. R1 text: After the equipping character hits an opponent with a Plunging Attack, all nearby party members' Plunging Attacks will deal 28% increased DMG for 20s. When nearby party members hit opponents with Plunging Attacks, they will restore 2.5 Energy to the equipping character. Energy can be restored this way every 0.7s. This energy regain effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is not on the field.
Obtain method is a guess from rarity and has not been verified in a source page.
Base ATK and secondary stat are from genshin-db only (not cross-checked in a second source).
